advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? En... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway, it has multiple meanings~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-covered town, an aged warrior is about to face his final hour, and his glorious old body is about to begin a new chapter.
txt.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.line1: Authorization tool for the Time Lords' forbidden weapon
txt.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.line2: Very few presidents have ever obtained the Key of Rassilon...
txt.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line2: Destroy this gun, destroy all its data, and do not let its immense power corrupt your mind...
txt.doctor_m.time_key_resurrection: §bThe power of the Time Key has reversed your death
txt.doctor_m.time_key.tip: The complete Time Key... It exists at all points in time, granting its holder access to the 'heart' of the universe.
txt.doctor_m.time_key_fragment.tip: Even a fragment of the Time Key still possesses a portion of its power...
